missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend potassium supplements until medication names, dose, kidney history and existing potassium-containing products are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer potassium deficiency from medication use or nonspecific symptoms.
Do not advise stopping or changing prescribed medicines.
Do not recommend potassium supplements or potassium-based salt substitutes without checking hyperkalemia risk.
professional_escalation_conditions: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, potassium-sparing diuretics or other medicines affecting potassium.
Chronic kidney disease, heart failure, known hyperkalemia or abnormal serum potassium.
population_and_context: Users taking regular medication who may be considering potassium supplementation; medication classes and renal function materially affect potassium balance.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Supplemental potassium requires assessment of serum potassium, renal function, indication and medication interactions.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet identifies medication interactions and hyperkalemia risk; prescribing decisions require clinical and laboratory context.
